description:
Indicators the U.S. Census Bureau publishes only at census-tract level — health insurance coverage, disability, nativity, group-quarters population, and race-iterated income and poverty — for all 104 census tracts in the City of St. Louis, from the American Community Survey (ACS) 2020–2024 5-year estimates. The Census Bureau describes the ACS as "an ongoing survey that provides vital information on a yearly basis about our nation and its people." The companion `acs-block-groups` collection carries the finer-grained indicators; this collection exists because tables like B27001 (health insurance), B18101 (disability), B05002 (nativity), B26001 (group quarters) and the race-iterated B19013B/B17020B have no block-group release. Population and median household income are repeated here as more statistically stable tract-level variants. Every estimate ships with its 90%-confidence margin of error (`*_moe`) and headline rates with a coefficient of variation (`*_cv`); jam values are nulls; each column's description names its ACS table.

Unlike the city's own datasets in this catalog, this is **not** City of St. Louis data: it is federal survey data published by the U.S. Census Bureau, extracted for St. Louis city (FIPS 29510) from the ACS table-based Summary File and joined to the Bureau's 2024 cartographic boundary geometries (1:500,000 scale, clipped to the Mississippi shoreline).

table:columns.name: geoid
table:columns.description: 11-digit census tract GEOID (state 29 + county 510 + tract). Join key; equals the first 11 characters of a block-group geoid.

table:columns.name: population
table:columns.description: Total population. ACS table B01003.

table:columns.name: population_moe
table:columns.description: Margin of error for population at the 90% confidence level (the level the Census Bureau publishes for ACS).

table:columns.name: median_hh_income
table:columns.description: Median household income in the past 12 months, in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars. ACS table B19013.

table:columns.name: median_hh_income_moe
table:columns.description: Margin of error for median_hh_income at the 90% confidence level (the level the Census Bureau publishes for ACS).

table:columns.name: median_hh_income_cv
table:columns.description: Coefficient of variation for median_hh_income (moe / 1.645 / estimate): at or below 0.15 is reliable, 0.15–0.30 use with caution, above 0.30 unreliable.

table:columns.name: pct_below_poverty
table:columns.description: Percent of the population for whom poverty status is determined with income below the poverty level (income-to-poverty ratio under 1.00). ACS table C17002.

table:columns.name: pct_below_poverty_moe
table:columns.description: Margin of error for pct_below_poverty at the 90% confidence level (the level the Census Bureau publishes for ACS).

table:columns.name: pct_below_poverty_cv
table:columns.description: Coefficient of variation for pct_below_poverty (moe / 1.645 / estimate): at or below 0.15 is reliable, 0.15–0.30 use with caution, above 0.30 unreliable.

table:columns.name: pct_uninsured
table:columns.description: Percent of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with no health insurance coverage. ACS table B27001.

table:columns.name: pct_uninsured_moe
table:columns.description: Margin of error for pct_uninsured at the 90% confidence level (the level the Census Bureau publishes for ACS).

table:columns.name: pct_uninsured_cv
table:columns.description: Coefficient of variation for pct_uninsured (moe / 1.645 / estimate): at or below 0.15 is reliable, 0.15–0.30 use with caution, above 0.30 unreliable.

table:columns.name: pct_with_disability
table:columns.description: Percent of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with a disability. ACS table B18101.

table:columns.name: pct_with_disability_moe
table:columns.description: Margin of error for pct_with_disability at the 90% confidence level (the level the Census Bureau publishes for ACS).

table:columns.description: Coefficient of variation for pct_with_disability (moe / 1.645 / estimate): at or below 0.15 is reliable, 0.15–0.30 use with caution, above 0.30 unreliable.

table:columns.name: pct_foreign_born
table:columns.description: Percent of the population that is foreign-born. ACS table B05002.

table:columns.name: pct_foreign_born_moe
table:columns.description: Margin of error for pct_foreign_born at the 90% confidence level (the level the Census Bureau publishes for ACS).

table:columns.name: group_quarters_pop
table:columns.description: Population living in group quarters (dormitories, prisons, nursing facilities and similar) — flag tracts where this is large before computing per-capita rates from household-based columns. ACS table B26001.

table:columns.name: group_quarters_pop_moe
